claim_boundary: Nine empirical predictors/baselines evaluated on two local CUDA-Q dense sample contexts. This is not an NVIDIA cost-model claim, Maestro reproduction, or simulator-independent runtime law.

target.hash_target_reduction: For each exact-QASM hash and precision, reduce five successful t_warm_execution_s repetitions to a median in each of three sessions, then take the median of the three session medians.
target.first_build_extraction_e2e: Descriptive clocks only; do not mix them into or substitute them for the warm target.
target.source: Reuse the hash-level targets already validated by R5 target revision v2. Do not retime rows as part of R8.

population.frontier_q10_q16: Retain in coverage/scaling tables; do not add to primary OOF fit or claim width-OOD accuracy.
population.unit_of_observation: exact qasm_sha256 after alias reduction; one target and at most one OOF prediction per hash, method, precision
population.target_eligibility: R5 targets_recovered_v2 only; require target_status=ok and exact normalized_ir_sha256/unitary_sha256 join with R3. No failure imputation.

representation.source: R3 repaired CUDA-Q-convertible normalized circuit IR; include terminal measurements; do not use Aer transpilation or MPS measurement-stripped features.
representation.gate_vocabulary: Fit on outer-training hashes only; map unseen outer-test operation names to a single unknown token.
representation.normalization: Model globals use log1p of nonnegative raw values followed by mean/std fitted on outer-training hashes only. Replace fitted std below 1e-6 with 1.0.
representation.work_scaled_multiqubit_count: Count normalized DAG operation nodes with arity >=3, excluding measure, barrier, and snapshot; this is the existing project convention multi_qubit_gate_count. It is distinct from the two-qubit count and is used only by work_scaled_ridge.

split.assignment_policy: Join R5 targets to the frozen C44 exact-hash fold; never regenerate or stratify a replacement split. Verify exact 150-hash coverage and no train/test hash overlap independently for both precision contexts.
split.claim_boundary: Exact-QASM instance-group OOF within one local simulator target and precision; not family holdout or width holdout. FP32 and FP64 are separate models and result tables.

linear_regression.features: Seven globals after log1p and train-only StandardScaler

ridge_alpha1.features: Seven globals after log1p and train-only StandardScaler

rbf_svr.features: Seven globals after log1p and train-only StandardScaler

random_forest.features: Seven globals after log1p and train-only StandardScaler

xgboost.features: Seven globals after log1p and train-only StandardScaler

mali_style_dense_graph.description: Local Ma-Li-style normalized operation DAG plus seven globals; not a source-native Ma-Li reproduction.
mali_style_dense_graph.architecture: Use the existing UnifiedGraphModel: three TransformerConv(64) layers with ReLU, global mean pool, seven-to-64-to-64 global branch, concatenate, 128-to-512-to-512-to-128-to-1 ReLU head.
mali_style_dense_graph.node_features: Outer-train gate vocabulary one-hot plus unknown bucket; arity one-hot clipped at 3; parameter-present; normalized min/mean/max wire position and position-present flag, using the existing S71 graph encoder.
mali_style_dense_graph.seed_reduction: retain seed predictions and report row-wise median plus seed range

matched_metadata_mlp.architecture: Seven-to-64-to-64-to-512-to-512-to-128-to-1 fully connected ReLU MLP, as in the frozen R7 matched baseline.
matched_metadata_mlp.seed_reduction: retain seed predictions and report row-wise median plus seed range

work_scaled_ridge.description: Internal work-scaled Ridge comparison only; not Maestro, a published law, or an identified launch-overhead model.
work_scaled_ridge.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on outer-training rows only

preflight_before_fit: verify exact 150-hash target/feature/fold join separately by precision
verify all targets finite positive and ok
verify no exact-hash overlap and frozen 37/28/26/25/34 fold counts
verify 124 arity>=3 gate nodes across the entire feature population with excluded measurement/barrier/snapshot operations
verify software versions and model params
execution.technical_canaries: CPU deterministic unit tests and a finite CUDA forward/backward + inference smoke test for both neural methods on the exact R8 graph schema; the CUDA gate runs only after the exclusive R7 GPU fit releases its lease.
execution.fold0_gate: Fit all nine methods in both precisions on fold 0; verify attempt coverage, target firewall, transforms, checkpoints/prediction identity, finite nonnegative outputs and three-seed reductions. Continue only on technical PASS, never on an accuracy threshold.
execution.automatic_sequence: After fold-0 technical QA, execute folds 1-4 in order per precision/method under exclusive GPU ownership for neural fits. Classical fits may run during R7 under a two-native-thread cap and otherwise no more than four aggregate CPU threads while GPU training runs.
execution.timing_concurrency: No R8 CUDA timing; R8 neural training runs one GPU worker after R7. Do not overlap R7/R8/R9/R10 GPU workloads.

completion_and_reporting.attempt_denominator: 150 hashes per method per precision (1,350 attempts per precision, 2,700 across both precision contexts).
completion_and_reporting.common_comparison: Report pairwise scores only on identical successful test hashes; separately retain assigned and predicted coverage for every method.
completion_and_reporting.status_policy: Never discard assigned identities. Preserve failed/unavailable attempt rows with explicit reason; do not impute predictions.
completion_and_reporting.reader_claim: Nine methods/baselines benchmarked on the same 150 exact-QASM hashes per precision under a local CUDA-Q dense sample(32) warm-execution target. FP32/FP64 are separate contexts.
